name: Flunky
source: Flunky is the main antagonist, the Cog who oversees the killing game. He is short-tempered and cruel, wanting to see the Toons kill each other as soon as possible.
translation: Flunky is the main antagonist, the Cog who oversees the killing game. He is short-tempered and cruel, wanting to see the Toons kill each other as soon as possible.
